name: Laya (local System-1)
description: Local System-1 decisions via the laya checkpoint: moderates inbound connector (IM) messages for spam/threat/harassment/toxic in one ~60 ms forward pass — no LLM call, en+zh via the laya Router.

tools.name: laya_status
tools.description: Report whether the local laya checkpoint is loaded, which checkpoint is configured, and check/block counters. Pass retry=true to retry a failed load immediately instead of waiting out the back-off.

tools.name: laya_moderate_check
tools.description: Run the inbound-moderation questions against arbitrary text and return scores for spam/toxic/harassment/threat/severity.

tools.name: laya_decide
tools.description: Ask arbitrary typed questions (choice/score/noul) about a state object in one forward pass. Returns {ok, answers, latencyMs, routing?, truncation?} or {ok: false, error: {kind, message}}.

state.description: State fields the questions reference, e.g. {"prompt": "..."}

questions.description: Typed questions keyed by answer name

permissionJustifications.python:execute: The plugin's hooks and tools run in the desktop Python host.
permissionJustifications.network:fetch: First use downloads the laya checkpoint weights (~1.3 GB) from HuggingFace; they are cached locally afterwards.

checkpoint.title: Checkpoint
checkpoint.description: 'auto' uses the laya Router to pick the checkpoint that can read each input (required for mixed-language traffic — the english checkpoint misfires on non-Latin text).

inboundModeration.title: Inbound moderation
inboundModeration.description: Score inbound connector messages (Lark/Slack/Discord/Telegram) on spam/threat/harassment/toxic.

inboundMode.title: Inbound mode
inboundMode.description: 'observe' scores messages and counts would-be-blocks in laya_status without dropping anything — the safe default for a fresh install. 'enforce' drops messages above the threshold.

inboundThreshold.title: Inbound threshold
inboundThreshold.description: noul probability above which an inbound message is dropped. Clean en/zh messages measured <=0.06; a clearly toxic message measured 0.77.

warmup.title: Warm up on startup
warmup.description: Start loading the checkpoint in the background when the plugin loads, so the first guarded turn is fast. Hooks always pass through while loading.

maxChars.title: Max input chars
maxChars.description: Only the head window is screened (~700 tokens); longer inputs are truncated and the verdict reports truncated=true.

browser.reason: Python plugins run in the desktop subprocess host.

mobile.reason: Python plugins run in the desktop subprocess host — unavailable on mobile.
